purpose: Implement the existing EG-CORRECT, EG-FAULT, and EG-INTEGRITY registry runners for the active xtask tooling scope without changing product behavior or Qualification Cell state.

change.public_seam: cargo xtask quality returned verdict and retained target/quality/evidence attempt
runner_changes: The active xtask tooling scope participates in risk-gate selection only through its own registered risk_gates set; no application, artifact, or deferred gate is inferred.
EG-CORRECT retains one bounded controlled state-model test that rejects mixed crash publication states and accepts only predecessor or successor recovery states.
EG-FAULT retains one bounded controlled fault-matrix test that rejects a missing publication-point schedule and requires one schedule per registered point.
EG-INTEGRITY retains one bounded controlled evidence-state test that rejects corrupted or missing retained evidence after restart.
Each selected runner command, timeout, memory declaration, stdout, stderr, verdict, command digest, and immutable raw-report binding remains validated by the existing evidence contract.
unchanged: All 25 gate IDs, stages, coordinators, timeouts, memory declarations, exception classes, targets, thresholds, and application activation ledgers.
Developer evidence remains diagnostic and non-merge-eligible.
Release Qualification Cells remain Specified; an engineering runner implementation does not qualify a product artifact.

detection_gained: An active xtask scope can no longer select EG-CORRECT, EG-FAULT, or EG-INTEGRITY and receive an unsupported-runner failure instead of a retained controlled result.
A mixed publication state, a missing fault schedule, and corrupted or absent restart evidence each fail their named registered runner through the public quality seam.
A successful controlled command with malformed or zero-test self-test output fails the named gate and retains its immutable failed evidence rather than being accepted as a pass.
The active tooling selection regression test proves EG-CONCURRENCY, EG-CRYPTO, EG-RESOURCE, and EG-SOAK remain explicitly not selected when xtask selects only its registered gates.

old.result: Before the change, an active registered EG-FAULT selection failed with an unsupported runner outcome.

new.result: The named state, fault, and integrity models and their three registry-selected public seams passed locally. These local results are diagnostic only.

compatibility_and_recovery.compatibility: The cargo xtask quality command and evidence schema remain unchanged. Correctness, fault, and integrity reports use the existing immutable selected-gate raw-report contract.
compatibility_and_recovery.recovery: Correct the failing model or controlled command and create a new quality attempt. Retain every failed attempt and its raw report; do not overwrite or reclassify earlier evidence.

approval.attribution: No implementation agent, reviewer, or repository owner is recorded as granting a required approval.

qualification_claim: None. This record does not claim a Qualified cell, trusted CI pass, merge eligibility, release readiness, or role approval.
